citations.claim: energy jumps above allowed limit at first violation step
heavy body gaining upward velocity from collision

counterfactual.change: Increased dt from 0.00059 to 0.0333 (1/30) to change collision resolution; with larger dt substep/collision handling conserves energy and violation disappears.

explanation: Two vertically stacked circles (heavy 19.3 kg on top, light 1 kg below launched upward at 24 m/s) collide. With tiny dt=0.00059 and gravity, positional correction / impulse is applied over many micro-steps while bodies remain in contact (gap ~0.001 at step 98, ~0.006 at 99), injecting energy each substep. Energy rises from 2024 J to 2342 J exceeding 10%+5J allowance, with no controller work.
vision_note: Steps 96-99 show two blue circles vertically stacked against the left edge remaining in almost continuous contact with negligible displacement or separation. There is no visible explosion, ejection, wall tunneling, or controller activity, just persistent sticking/jitter while the reported energy jumps by ~300 J.
